issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for 'Book.author': the problem statement (problem_statement.md lines 16-18) specifies that Book.author is a String, but the reference implementation declares Book.author as Bool (Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift line 28). The Client (Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift lines 34-36) constructs Book instances passing String literals for the author. This inconsistency will cause compilation errors and confuses students about the expected type for the author field.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the type of the 'author' property in the Book struct from Bool to String in Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift so it matches the problem specification and the places where Book is instantiated (e.g. Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift). Update any implementations or tests that rely on the incorrect Bool type accordingly.
